title: docs/adr: adr:index is stale for ADR-0160 on main
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6Cb4BAjgQ43tqy1DvVJ

Filing gate: ② follow-up found while reviewing #37304 (PR #37676, contract record 7206413701 note "adr:index stale for ADR-0160 on main, carrier: none", seat REWORK 7206423476), filed by zone ai-37000 at the seat's direction, per the maintainer's standing permission for areas to file follow-up cards.
Grading: area:ai · domain:skills · Task · p3 · reach: the generated ADR index · evidence: read.

## 维护者速读

- 做什么：ADR 目录索引没跟上 ADR-0160 的最新修订，重新生成即可。
- 谁受益：查 ADR 的人和读索引的工具看到的是最新内容。
- 不做会怎样：索引与正文不一致；功能不受影响。
- 需要你做的：无（docs/adr 是受治理面，按惯例合入）。

## What

The generated ADR index (`adr:index`) on `main` does not match ADR-0160 after its amendments (see #37490 / PR #37573). Not caused by #37304; found by its reviewer.

## Acceptance

- `adr:index` regenerated on main; its check passes with no other index change.
